difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every admissible blowup of the spectrum of the completion of a Noetherian local ring with respect to the punctured spectrum is the base change of an admissible blowup of the spectrum of the ring (statement lines 3028-3033). The proof (proof lines 3034-3050) descends the defining ideal using the comparison of quotients by powers of the maximal ideal and applies flat base change of blowing up. H2: a complete short argument.
